description: Source code implementing UTF-8, UTF-16, and UTF-32 string conversion functions within the google_breakpad namespace, including conversions and character swapping.

methods.name: UTF8ToUTF16
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 encoded string to UTF-16 and stores the result in a vector.

methods.name: UTF8ToUTF16Char
methods.description: Converts a single UTF-8 character to UTF-16, returning the number of bytes processed.

methods.name: UTF32ToUTF16
methods.description: Converts a UTF-32 string to UTF-16 and stores the result in a vector.

methods.name: UTF32ToUTF16Char
methods.description: Converts a single UTF-32 character to UTF-16.

methods.name: UTF16ToUTF8
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 vector to a UTF-8 string, with optional byte swapping.
